How it works

From a demo to your story

Five simple steps. You pick, you share, we build with love.

1

Pick a demo

Open the demos, play with them and choose the one that feels like your person.

2

Say hello

Tap “I like this” or message us on WhatsApp and tell us the occasion.

3

Share your details

Names, dates, photos, your message and the music you want. Any style, any colours.

4

We build it

We make your website by hand, with your story, your music and your design.

5

Review & adjust

You preview it and tell us what to tweak, until it feels perfect.

6

Private link delivered

You receive a private link to share with your person. Delivered within 2–3 days.

About us

Crafted for your special moments

CodedWithLove.Studio is a small creative studio in Pakistan making interactive websites for life’s most important moments.

8Live demos
4Occasions
2–3Days delivery

Why we do this

A message is nice. A gift is lovely. But a little world made only for one person, with their name, their photos and their song, is something they keep forever. That is what we build.

Every website is designed to open on a phone, play its own music, and feel like opening a surprise. Birthdays, anniversaries, engagements and weddings, for people all over the world.

🎨

Made for you

No templates with your name pasted in. Colours, music and story are shaped around your person.

📱

Phone first

Smooth, fast and beautiful on the screen your loved one will actually open it on.

💌

Private & personal

Delivered as a private link, so you decide who gets to see it.

Legal

Privacy Policy

Last updated: October 2026

This website is a showcase of demo websites by CodedWithLove.Studio. We keep things simple and collect as little as possible.

What this website collects

This website has no accounts, no sign-up forms and no advertising. We do not use analytics or tracking cookies, and we do not store anything you type here on a server.

When you contact us

If you tap WhatsApp, email or a social link, or use the contact form, your message is sent through that service (WhatsApp, your email provider, Instagram, TikTok or Facebook), and their own privacy policies apply. The contact form only prepares a WhatsApp message on your device. We receive it only if you press send.

Your project details

If you place an order and share names, dates, photos, music or stories with us, we use them only to build your website. We do not sell them or share them with anyone else. You can ask us to delete your materials once your project is finished.

Third-party services

  • This site is hosted on GitHub Pages, which may keep standard server logs such as IP addresses.
  • Fonts are loaded from Google Fonts, which may receive your IP address when the page loads.

Questions

Write to us at email and we will be happy to help.

Legal

Terms & Conditions

Last updated: October 2026

1. Demos

The websites shown here are demos for preview only. Names, dates, photos, music and text in them are examples and can be changed in your own order.

2. Orders

A custom website starts when you confirm your order with us on WhatsApp or email. We agree the details, price and payment before any work begins.

3. Delivery

We aim to deliver your website as a private link within 2–3 days after we receive everything we need from you. Delivery time can change depending on how quickly you share your details and the changes you ask for.

4. Your content

You confirm that you have the right to use the photos, music, text and names you give us. This includes any song you ask us to add. We are not responsible for copyright claims on materials supplied by you.

5. Changes

We will adjust your website with you until you are happy. The amount of changes included is agreed when the order is confirmed.

6. Our work

The designs and code of our demos belong to CodedWithLove.Studio and may not be copied or resold. Your finished website is for your own personal use.

7. Availability

Your link is hosted with a third-party provider, so we cannot promise it will always be online. Please keep a copy of your photos and details.

8. Contact

Questions about these terms? Write to email.
